name: MA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with an 11-point partisan lean
Incumbent Jake Auchincloss running with a large financial advantage
Republican opponent minimally funded with no outside support
Prediction markets price Democratic win at 97%
model.rationale: The district's 11-point Democratic lean, Auchincloss's incumbency and $7.3 million war chest against a Republican rival who has raised under $27,000, and markets pricing a Democratic win at 97% all point to a safe Democratic hold. No polls or expert ratings exist, so uncertainty stays moderately wide.
model.watch: Any late surge of outside spending or a polling surprise could narrow the margin, though nothing currently signals a competitive race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jake Auchincloss seeks a fourth term in a Massachusetts district that leans Democratic by 11 points. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, holding $7.3 million after raising $3.6 million, while Republican Thomas Stalcup has raised about $26,000 with minimal cash on hand and no outside support. Prediction markets give Auchincloss a 97% chance of winning.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the funding gap, and market pricing. All signs point to a comfortable Democratic hold, with the main open question being the size of the margin rather than the winner.
